resources.string: Lab 03: Options Menu, Navigation & Toast Feedback

This app demonstrates Options Menu, Navigation, and Toast feedback.
Lab 03 - ICS 2300 JKUAT Mobile Application Development
Features: - Options Menu with 3 actions - Toast feedback for each action - Persistent validation errors - Navigation with unsaved changes warning - State preservation across rotation - Fault diagnosis example

No records saved yet.
Use "Add Record" from the menu to add student records.
You have unsaved input. Discard changes and view records?

Deliberate fault demonstration:
Fault: Mismatched menu item ID in onOptionsItemSelected() Symptom: Menu selection does nothing (no Toast, no navigation) Cause: Code checks for R.id.action_view_record (singular) but menu defines @+id/action_view_records (plural) Correction: Use exact ID from menu resource: R.id.action_view_records Retest: After fix, selection works correctly
Check Logcat (tag: MainActivity) for trace.
